purpose: Separate empirically observable platform opportunity/view stages from the existing CBD cognitive ExposureEvent so real platform data can constrain components without silently redefining q_transmit.

potential_delivery.definition: Content is eligible or potentially available to a recipient under the dataset/platform-specific relation and observation window.

platform_view.definition: A platform-recorded content view or seen event under the source dataset's operational definition.

cognitive_exposure.definition: Existing CBD ExposureEvent entering the Familiarity update.

synthetic_parameter_boundary.recovery_definition: P(realised recipient ExposureEvent | realised Share-edge opportunity)
synthetic_parameter_boundary.reason: The recovered synthetic shortcut may conflate potential delivery, platform view, and cognitive exposure.

source_mapping.title: Potential Exposure to Facebook Posts with Civic News URLs
source_mapping.documented_measurement: users who potentially viewed posts with civic-news URLs shared by one of their connections; potential audience size

source_mapping.title: Exposure to Facebook Posts with Civic News URLs
source_mapping.documented_measurement: users who viewed posts with civic-news URLs; content views and audience size

source_mapping.title: Engagement with Facebook Posts with Civic News URLs
source_mapping.documented_measurement: users who engaged with posts and engagement volume; content views and audience size included

source_mapping.title: Passive-Tracking Participants' Daily Views of Facebook Posts with Civic News Domains
source_mapping.documented_measurement: participants' daily views of posts with civic-news domains

source_mapping.title: Participant Exposure to Deceptive Online Networks
source_mapping.documented_measurement: participant exposure and engagement with a specific deceptive online network aggregated over a period

source_mapping.title: Facebook Intervention Experiment Participants
source_mapping.documented_measurement: user attributes, user connections, time spent, content views, content engagement

source_mapping.title: AT Protocol feed interactionSeen
source_mapping.documented_measurement: protocol token for feed item seen by user with item/request context fields

non_claims: No empirical q_transmit value is estimated.
No new runtime event or active parameter is introduced.
No SOMAR aggregate is treated as a dyadic Share-to-View probability.
No platform view is automatically treated as cognitive exposure.
